Home.metaDescription: A bridge between sustainable Mexican companies and the Italian market. Companies, ecosystem, and providers on one site.

hero.title: Sustainable Mexico, with a door into Italy
hero.description: It brings together Puebla's ecosystem, the companies from that ecosystem that want to be introduced in Italy, and the providers who make the landing operable.
hero.mapLabel: Map of Mexico with Puebla in the platform color

allies.label: Social, environmental, and technological innovation
allies.note: The Plastics Cluster is the site and the commercial mission, and it invites the Startups Cluster.

paths.title: Ecosystem, companies, and providers
paths.intro: The site is not a single list. Puebla organizes its industry in clusters, companies from that ecosystem present their offer, and providers make it possible for that offer to land in Italy.

chapters.title: Ecosystem
chapters.description: In Mexico, Puebla has an articulated industry. These clusters are that articulation, gathered in three tables, with the support of the Government of Puebla and the Secretariat of Economic Development and Tourism.

points.title: Transformation
points.description: Those who turn material into product: plastics, auto, textile, food, energy, stone, wood, chemicals, metal, and construction. Plastics opens the table.

points.title: Services
points.description: Startups, talent, technology, and the creative economy. The Startup and Innovation Cluster opens the table.

points.title: Tourism
points.description: Those who receive the visit: the city, health, hospitality, and the mountain ranges.

chapters.title: Companies
chapters.description: Companies from the ecosystem that already have a profile. The directory opens with three from the Startup and Innovation Cluster: Concora, Radek, and Sabia. The small mark shows which cluster they come from.

points.title: What they do
points.description: One line on the offer, the problem they address, and the solution they propose.

points.title: Where they come from
points.description: The cluster logo sits next to the name, so the company is read inside its table.

points.title: How to reach them
points.description: Website, email, or phone, with the profile in Spanish, English, and Italian.

chapters.title: Providers
chapters.description: The people who make the crossing to Italy operable. Without that support, the introduction stays an intention. Example profiles are replaced once the provider confirms its details.

points.title: Logistics
points.description: Freight, customs, and delivery between Mexico and Italy.

points.title: Language and distribution
points.description: Translation of profiles, materials, and meetings, and the path for the product to reach the buyer.

bridge.title: From Puebla's industry to the Italian market
bridge.lead: First the table that organizes the offer, then the company that introduces itself, and finally whoever makes the crossing work.

steps.title: The ecosystem sorts the offer
steps.description: Puebla's clusters say which industry each company comes from and who sits at the same table.

steps.title: The company introduces itself
steps.description: Product, problem, and solution, in Spanish, English, and Italian, with its cluster mark.

steps.title: Providers make the crossing operable
steps.description: Paperwork, logistics, language, and distribution so the landing does not stay an intention.

closing.title: What is published is confirmed
closing.description: Ecosystem, companies, and providers show the structure of the site. A profile stays once the organization confirms its details.
